scope: R01 and R02 of docs/reviews/CORE-PLATFORM-READINESS-2026-11-13.md: bounded app API responses in the gateways, and a frame runtime that resends only 401s Core produced before any app saw the request. Isolated tools only; not deployed.
changes: app_response::read reads an app response chunk by chunk and stops at 4 MiB (app_response::LIMIT) whatever Content-Length says; at most 64 bodies are read at once (10 s wait, then 503 app_gateway_busy). runtime::proxy (CLI and delegated bearers, frame /_miy/api, app-to-app connections) and the local preview use it. Oversized answers are 502 app_response_too_large / preview_response_too_large; the existing 15 s (Core) and 20 s (preview) timeouts still bound slow bodies

app_response::api marks app answers with an internal FromApp extension (never sent). The frame listener adds x-miy-frame-credential: rejected only to 401 responses Core produced; app headers never pass the gateway, so an app cannot produce the mark
web/frame-runtime resends after renewal only a marked 401; an app's own 401 (any method) is returned once. Renewal 5 s before token expiry stays
Fixture HealthApp gained a PUT save button; tests/frame-mock.ts replies can carry headers

checks.observed: 3 tests: 4 MiB fits and 4 MiB + 1 is refused with and without Content-Length (chunked); app answers carry FromApp

129 observations (frames 14). The frames request-rule observation now also checks: an invalid frame token's 401 carries the mark, a probe app's 401 that sets the same header arrives without it, a 4 MiB answer passes whole, 4 MiB + 1 with Content-Length and a chunked answer without it are 502 app_response_too_large
